changelog:
Vanguard v1.0.51
- New Reinject pulse: bind a key to instantly reinject all buffered 3074 packets you are holding (a one-shot pulse, not a toggle - it flashes once).
- New master ticking switch in the main window (the tiny slider under the status text). Turn it off for "WinDivert Inactive": all ports are forced off and port hotkeys are ignored, while the overlay, sessions, leaderboards, and timers keep working.
- Added a 3074 DL Slow keybind (delay inbound), completing the 3074 slow pair.
- Session Reconnect button now flashes briefly when pulsed instead of latching on/off like the other ports.
- Added a Help button (bottom-right of the main window) that opens the community Discord.
- Refreshed the bundled README/user guide: ports, UI customization, FAQ, and a changelog.
